name: pdfmonkey-mcp-server
description: Generate PDFs from templates using PDFMonkey API - manage templates, documents, and snippets
author: PDFMonkey

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: List all PDFMonkey workspaces accessible with the current API key

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List all PDF templates available in the workspace. Optionally scope the listing to a specific workspace with workspace_id.

parameters.name: workspace_id
parameters.description: Optional workspace (app) ID to scope the template listing. When omitted, uses the default workspace.

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific template including HTML, CSS, and sample data

parameters.name: template_id
parameters.description: The ID of the template to retrieve

tools.name: generate_document
tools.description: Generate a PDF document from a template with provided data. Uses async generation with automatic polling until completion.

parameters.name: template_id
parameters.description: The ID of the template to use for generation

parameters.name: workspace_id
parameters.description: Optional workspace (app) ID to generate the document in. When omitted, uses the default workspace.

parameters.name: payload
parameters.description: The data to merge into the template (must match template structure)

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: Optional filename for the generated PDF (e.g., 'invoice-001.pdf')

parameters.name: meta
parameters.description: Optional additional metadata to store with the document

tools.name: get_document_status
tools.description: Check the generation status of a document and get its download URL if ready

parameters.name: document_id
parameters.description: The ID of the document to check

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: List documents with optional filtering by status, template, or update time

tools.name: delete_document
tools.description: Permanently delete a document and its generated PDF

parameters.name: document_id
parameters.description: The ID of the document to delete

tools.name: list_snippets
tools.description: List all reusable Liquid code snippets in the workspace

tools.name: get_snippet
tools.description: Get the Liquid code of a specific snippet

parameters.name: snippet_id
parameters.description: The ID of the snippet to retrieve

tools.name: get_quota
tools.description: Get current quota and plan information for the account

tools.name: get_user_info
tools.description: Get complete user account information including personal details, plan, and settings

PDFMONKEY_API_KEY.description: Your PDFMonkey API key from dashboard.pdfmonkey.io
